client_frame: **CORRECTION on ATH claims**: Mon was a strong session (+1.3-1.8%) on strike-cancel + ISM 55.6 blowout, but it was NOT a triple record. **Only DJI closed at a new record close** (53,178.41 vs Jul 6 prior close ATH 53,055.91; Mon high 53,230 still under Jul 7 high 53,289). **SPX 7,600.50 is still under the June 2 close ATH of 7,609.78** (−0.12%). **NDX 28,776.80 is still ~6.1% under the June 2 close ATH of 30,660.60** (June 3 high 30,762.20). Prior brief wrongly labeled all three as records. The substantive setup still holds: ISM Employment flipped to expansion after 33 months, Production highest since 2021, and **yields FELL** (10Y −5.7bp to 4.688%, 2Y −10.8bp to 4.252%) — a bull steepener despite the manufacturing surge. **Iran signals still diverge** (president MOU claim vs FM denial; Hormuz traffic still ~6 vessels Mon). **Client positioning**: (a) strength is real but NDX is a recovery rally off July lows, not price discovery at highs; (b) keep cheap VIX protection — deal not signed; (c) AMD tonight carries earnings risk; (d) NFP Fri is still THE catalyst.
